Misty's special lure is a created by to help with her fishing for Pokémon. It is a small model of Misty herself in style. She believes it to be the best in her collection of lures, and gets sensitive when is skeptical of this. It appears to have undergone many redesigns, or she otherwise may have multiple lures of herself, but most versions depict Misty in her original outfit.

==History==
Misty's special lure debuted in the banned episode EP035, alongside six other lures, including a , , , , , and lure. "The Misty Special" debuted internationally in Bye Bye Psyduck.

Misty has used the lure herself several times, like when she was trying to catch a in The Totodile Duel; and during the Seaking Catching Competition in Hook, Line, and Stinker.

Misty asked to deliver a lure to Ash as a gift when he met him in The Unbeatable Lightness of Seeing!. During said episode, it was again referred to as "Misty's Special". Ash later used it to fish for a in Buizel Your Way Out Of This!, and when asked to use it, he refused, leading to a short squabble between the two. Later in the episode, Buizel stole their rods, including Ash's with the lure attached; however, it was later recovered.

In The One That Didn't Get Away!, was revealed to have received a lure of her own from Misty as a gift. She covered it with Antidote-laced food to cure a that had been ed by Hunter D, who was aiming to steal it.

In A Fated Face-Off!, Misty used her lure in an attempt to catch a that Ash was also trying to catch. She also mentioned the one that she had previously given to Ash. It reappeared in Ride, Lapras, Ride!.
